comment: fsd: every user story 1-76 maps to a slice's criteria, but the order breaks what the person asked for (prefactorings first, then the push rule, merge step, story edit refusal, light path / re-approval and base side, then re-verify, overlap, regenerate and ask-instead-of-abort). Fix depends_on only: (a) slices 04 merge step, 06 story edit refusal and 10 base side have depends_on [] so they start beside the prefactoring slice 01; make each depend on gh-337/01. (b) slices 12 overlap and 14 ask-instead-of-abort have depends_on [] and 11 re-verify / 13 regenerate depend only on 04 / 07, so they can land before changes 1-5 finish; make 11, 12, 13 and 14 each also depend on the last slices of changes 1-5: gh-337/03, gh-337/05, gh-337/06, gh-337/08, gh-337/09, gh-337/10 (11 keeps 04, 13 keeps 07). Update slice 01's Notes, which say the others start in parallel. Content and criteria are fine otherwise.
